title.zh: 【嘉信理财：所有客户现已可使用 Schwab Crypto，年底前将新增 3 种加密资产】
title.en: 【嘉信理财：所有客户现已可使用 Schwab Crypto，年底前将新增 3 种加密资产】

current_state.zh: Charles Schwab said all clients can now access Schwab Crypto, with gradual rollout of crypto transfer-in functionality and three additional crypto assets (SOL, AVAX, LINK) to be added by year-end, positioning crypto and prediction markets as new trading-revenue sources.
